title: Marvel Super Heroes (Japan) demo V1.000: late-code candidate
summary: Deliver the demo branch's two guarded NOPs and select 1 MiB expansion RAM.
rationale: The exact Redump demo carries product 6106664. MSH.BIN begins at FAD 253 and loads at 06002000; its demo-specific target instructions and 23301FF0 guards occupy FAD 260. The retail source locations do not match this image. A fixed-clock emulator control redirects only the inherited first-program pointer and executes the exact compiled menu handler/helper at their original addresses with 1 MiB RAM preselected. The candidate matches all 121 sampled video, audio CRC, sample-count and visible-pixel checkpoints through frame 7201. Physical cartridge timing and other paths remain open; keep inactive.
